## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A two-juan Tang Huáyán-school commentary on the *Vajracchedikā Prajñāpāramitā-sūtra*, by Zhìyǎn 智儼 (602–668), the second patriarch of the Huáyán 華嚴 school (the foundational systematizer of Huáyán doctrine, between [杜順](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%9D%9C%E9%A0%86) Dùshùn the first patriarch and [法藏](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%B3%95%E8%97%8F) Fǎzàng the third patriarch). *notBefore* = 640 (Zhìyǎn's mature scholarly period); *notAfter* = 668 (Zhìyǎn's death).

**Abstract**

Zhìyǎn 智儼 (602–668) was the principal early Huáyán-doctrinal systematizer — establishing the framework of Huáyán *yuánjiào* doctrine that [法藏](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%B3%95%E8%97%8F) Fǎzàng (643–712) would later bring to its mature systematic form. The present *Vajracchedikā* commentary applies early Huáyán doctrinal categories to the *prajñā* sūtra.
